title: Lendflow Roundup | March
summary: As we prepare to close out Q1, we’ve got a lot to share this month at Lendflow. From being named LendTech of the Year by FinTech Breakthrough to rolling out new features that make workflow orchestration easier, it’s been a busy month for the team. We’re also diving into ways to speed up underwriting and improve portfolio performance with smarter loan placement - and if you’ll be at Fintech Meetup, we’d love to see you there.

###### COMPANY NEWS


### What We're Excited About


### [Lendflow Named “Overall LendTech Company of the Year” by FinTech Breakthrough](https://www.lendflow.com/post/lendflow-named-lendtech-of-the-year-by-fintech-breakthrough?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=roundup&utm_content=March)


Lendflow has been named “Overall LendTech Company of the Year” in the 2026 FinTech Breakthrough Awards, recognizing our leadership in AI-driven lending infrastructure and embedded finance. We’re honored to be recognized alongside some of the most innovative companies shaping the future of fintech.


[Learn More >](https://www.lendflow.com/post/lendflow-named-lendtech-of-the-year-by-fintech-breakthrough?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=roundup&utm_content=March)

###### UPDATES


### What We're Working On


### [Introducing Branch Reconnection and Reusable Paths](https://www.lendflow.com/post/new-at-lendflow-simplifying-data-orchestration-with-branch-reconnection-and-reusable-paths)


Branch Reconnection and Reusable Paths make it easier to build and manage workflows by allowing multiple branches to converge into shared logic. This reduces duplication, speeds up workflow creation, and keeps decisioning systems cleaner and easier to maintain over time.


[See How it Works >](https://www.lendflow.com/post/new-at-lendflow-simplifying-data-orchestration-with-branch-reconnection-and-reusable-paths)
